fixtures.title: Launch, reopen, resume, and offline recovery
fixtures.fixture: Fresh launch, reopen an existing thread, then temporarily remove provider access.
fixtures.pass_criterion: Ten consecutive attempts restore the correct active thread without losing a completed response.

fixtures.title: Thread streaming and immediate cancellation
fixtures.fixture: Start a deterministic long response and interrupt it while output is streaming.
fixtures.pass_criterion: Cancellation is visible promptly, no worker remains running, and the partial receipt is retained.

fixtures.title: Local terminal lifecycle
fixtures.fixture: Create a local PowerShell session; verify output, resize, Ctrl+C, and close.
fixtures.pass_criterion: The session streams output, interrupts the foreground command, and closes without an orphan process.

fixtures.title: Scoped multi-file coding task
fixtures.fixture: Apply a known small repair in an isolated worktree and run its focused test command.
fixtures.pass_criterion: Expected diff and test result are produced with no writes outside the supplied worktree.

fixtures.title: Major-risk approval gate
fixtures.fixture: Request a simulated bulk deletion or firmware operation; do not execute a real destructive action.
fixtures.pass_criterion: The action is blocked until explicit local approval is recorded and the receipt identifies the approval.

fixtures.title: Private per-agent context with shared findings
fixtures.fixture: Run independent agents containing mutually exclusive private facts and a shared ledger fact.
fixtures.pass_criterion: Each agent uses the shared finding but does not reveal another agent's private fact.

fixtures.title: Parallel decomposition and synthesis
fixtures.fixture: Split four independent research or code-inspection branches and combine their evidence.
fixtures.pass_criterion: All branches complete or report a bounded failure; synthesis cites each completed branch exactly once.

fixtures.title: Run receipt, interruption, and recovery
fixtures.fixture: Interrupt a task after it creates its execution receipt, then reopen the task state.
fixtures.pass_criterion: The receipt is redacted, durable, and sufficient to explain the next recovery action.

fixtures.title: Headless local-model worker
fixtures.fixture: Start the configured local model worker and request status with the model unavailable and available.
fixtures.pass_criterion: Health status is accurate and failure is actionable without opening a desktop window.

fixtures.title: Paired performance measurement
fixtures.fixture: Run the same fixed task after warmup on equivalent environment settings.
fixtures.pass_criterion: Record p95 latency and resource use; OBus p95 is no more than 1.5 times Codex for the selected lane.

fixtures.title: Install, upgrade, and shortcut integrity
fixtures.fixture: Install a signed build, upgrade it, and validate desktop/start-menu links without touching another client.
fixtures.pass_criterion: The selected version launches, the old version remains recoverable, and every shortcut points to the selected build.

fixtures.title: Repeatable report and release gate
fixtures.fixture: Generate paired receipts and this report from a fixed manifest.
fixtures.pass_criterion: The report is deterministic, includes every fixture, and fails release on incomplete or unsafe evidence.
